sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.html:
clarity /ˈklærəti/: being easy to understand.

clarity: sự rõ ràng.

concise /kənˈsaɪs/: brief but complete.

concise: ngắn gọn.

paraphrase /ˈpærəfreɪz/: express an idea in different words.

paraphrase: diễn đạt lại.

feedback /ˈfiːdbæk/: information about performance.

feedback: phản hồi.

structure /ˈstrʌktʃər/: organised arrangement.

structure: cấu trúc.

ambiguity /ˌæmbɪˈɡjuːəti/: more than one possible meaning.

ambiguity: sự mơ hồ.
